name: Fuzz4All
org: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, ETH Zurich
one_liner: Universal compiler and solver fuzzer that generates and mutates source-code fuzzing inputs with an LLM, seeding each iteration with a randomly chosen valid earlier input; coverage is the evaluation measure.

loop.proposes: An autoprompting and fuzzing LLM generates and mutates valid source inputs in C, C++, Go, Rust, Java, and SMT2.
loop.judged_by: Target compilers (GCC, Clang, rustc, Go) and solvers (Z3, CVC5) execute the inputs; crashes and output checks flag bugs.
loop.steers: The next iteration is seeded with a randomly chosen valid earlier input.

headline_result: Achieved 36.8% higher line coverage than language-specific fuzzers across 9 systems in 6 languages and found 98 bugs (64 confirmed previously unknown).
caveat: LLM token generation is slower per input than bit-flip greybox fuzzers, trading raw throughput for semantic validity in complex input grammars.
beyond_harness_note: A fuzzing loop seeds each iteration with a randomly chosen valid earlier input while calling the LLM as a cross-language input mutator.

sources.title: Fuzz4All: Universal Fuzzing with Large Language Models (ICSE 2024 / arXiv:2308.04748)

verification.notes: Checked against Xia et al., ICSE 2024.
